subsystem: Static Asset Serving + /desk and /app Redirect HTML Rendering
summary: Spec for ferro to serve Desk SPA: static assets (bundles, fonts, icons, sounds, SVGs), /desk HTML page render with templated boot JSON, and /app->desk redirect. Render strategy: minijinja template with pre-built HTML template to avoid jinja complexity. Asset serving: three-tier lookup (sites/assets -> apps/<app>/public -> symbolic mapping).

items.name: /app redirect endpoint
items.implementation_plan: Router: match GET /app/* or /app (without trailing slash). For /app, return 301 redirect Location: /desk. For /app/<path>, return 301 redirect Location: /desk/<path> (preserving query string if forward_query_parameters=true per hooks). Use util::parse_url to extract segments and reconstruct redirect path. Status code 301 (permanent).
items.response_contract: 301 status with Location header: /desk (or /desk/form/DocType/name if path)

items.name: /desk HTML page render
items.implementation_plan: Router: match GET /desk or /desk/* (paths like /desk/form/DocType/name). Return 200 with rendered desk.html template. Use minijinja2 crate for template rendering. Pre-embed desk.html template as a constant Rust string. Context variables: boot (JSON from frappe.sessions.get()), csrf_token (from frappe.sessions.get_csrf_token()), build_version (constant 'ferro-<git-hash>' or timestamp), dev_server (hardcoded false to disable live reload), layout_direction (from lang: 'rtl' or 'ltr'), lang (default 'en'), app_name (from conf/system settings, default 'Frappe'), desk_theme (from boot.user.desk_theme, default 'Light'), favicon (default '/assets/frappe/images/frappe-favicon.svg'), app_include_js/css/icons (from hooks, pre-resolved to hashed paths), sounds (from hooks). Auth: require session cookie (already validated by auth layer before route).
items.response_contract: 200 status, Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8. Full desk.html with <script>window.frappe.boot = {...}</script> (JSON embedded, size ~100-200KB), <link> for CSS bundles, <script src=> for JS bundles, icon SVG fetches, audio elements, CSRF token in frappe.csrf_token variable.

items.name: Static asset serving /assets/*
items.implementation_plan: Router: match GET /assets/<app>/... and /assets/<path>. Implement three-tier lookup: (1) check sites/assets/<path> (built/hashed bundles + symlink to frappe public), (2) if symlink fails or dist not found, check apps/<app>/<app>/public/<path>, (3) return 404 if not found. For /assets/frappe/dist/js/desk.bundle.XXXXX.js, resolve via sites/assets (or apps/frappe/frappe/public/dist). For /assets/frappe/images/frappe-favicon.svg, resolve via symlink to apps/frappe/frappe/public/images. For /assets/frappe/icons/lucide/icons.svg, resolve via symlink -> apps/frappe/frappe/public/icons. For /assets/frappe/css/fonts/inter/InterVariable.woff2, resolve via symlink -> apps/frappe/frappe/public/css/fonts. Use std::fs to serve file content with correct MIME type (from file extension: .js -> application/javascript, .css -> text/css, .svg -> image/svg+xml, .woff2 -> font/woff2, .mp3 -> audio/mpeg, .png/jpg -> image/*, etc.). Cache headers: immutable for hashed filenames (if hash in name, Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000), revalidate for unhashed (Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600).
items.response_contract: 200 status, Content-Type: application/javascript; body is file bytes. Cache-Control: immutable, public, max-age=31536000.

items.name: Asset path resolution (assets.json)
items.implementation_plan: Load sites/assets/assets.json at startup (read once, cache in memory as HashMap<String, String>). Use to resolve logical bundle names (desk.bundle.js) to hashed paths (/assets/frappe/dist/js/desk.bundle.TO2EIKWZ.js). During desk.html template render, look up app_include_js and app_include_css entries in the assets map. For app_include_icons (already absolute paths like /assets/frappe/icons/lucide/icons.svg), use as-is. Store assets map in App struct for thread-safe access (Arc<RwLock<HashMap>> or immutable Arc after boot). On render, substitute resolved bundle paths into the Jinja template context.

items.name: HTML template system (desk.html)
items.implementation_plan: Use minijinja2 crate for lightweight Jinja2 template rendering. Store desk.html as an embedded constant string in ferrod.rs. Desk.html template mirrors frappe/www/desk.html with variable substitutions: {{ boot|json }}, {{ csrf_token }}, {{ build_version }}, {{ dev_server }}, {{ app_name }}, {{ desk_theme }}, {{ layout_direction }}, {{ lang }}, {{ favicon }}, {% for include in app_include_js %} {{ include_script(include) }} {% endfor %}, etc. Rust include_script/include_style/include_icons functions: resolve bundle name via assets map, return <script src=> or <link> tags. Boot is pre-rendered as JSON string (orjson equivalent in Rust, use serde_json::to_string). Substitution strategy: create a HashMap<&str, Value> context, call minijinja env.get_template() and render().
items.response_contract: Rendered HTML string, ~130KB with embedded boot JSON

items.name: Frappe.boot context data
items.implementation_plan: Reuse existing pyrt/orm infrastructure to populate boot. Call frappe.sessions.get() via PyO3 to fetch the user's boot dict (already available in ferrod's py_boot setup). Extract: user (name, roles, desk_theme, email, etc.), doctypes, nav_sidebar, module_app, lang, etc. Convert to serde_json::Value via pyo3 conversion. Serialize to JSON string with serde_json::to_string_pretty() (or compact). Pass into Jinja template as context['boot']. If pyrt not available yet, fallback to stub boot (see stub section) with minimal user object to unblock HTML render.
items.response_contract: JSON object with keys: user (object), doctypes (array), module_app (object), permissions (object), lang (string), etc.

items.name: CSRF token generation
items.implementation_plan: Call frappe.sessions.get_csrf_token() via PyO3 to fetch or generate CSRF token from session. Pass into template as csrf_token variable. Token is embedded in HTML as <script>frappe.csrf_token = '{{ csrf_token }}';</script>. If pyrt unavailable, use a stub: generate a random 20-char hex string via rand crate and store in session/cookie.

items.name: App hooks resolution (app_include_js, app_include_css, app_include_icons)
items.implementation_plan: Hardcode the hooks values from frappe/hooks.py into ferrod.rs (static per deployment). app_include_js: [libs, billing, desk, list, form, controls, report, telemetry].bundle.js. app_include_css: [desk, report].bundle.css. app_include_icons: 4 icon SVG paths from /assets/frappe/icons/*. During desk.html render, resolve js/css via assets.json, icons as-is. If pyrt enabled, call frappe.get_hooks() to fetch dynamic hooks.
items.response_contract: Arrays of bundle names (js/css) and absolute icon paths

items.name: Sounds list from hooks
items.implementation_plan: Hardcode 7 standard sounds: email (0.1), submit (0.1), cancel (0.1), delete (0.05), click (0.05), error (0.1), alert (0.2). Each references /assets/frappe/sounds/<name>.mp3. In desk.html, emit <audio id=sound-<name>> elements via Jinja {% for %} loop.

items.name: Build version constant
items.implementation_plan: Use const BUILD_VERSION: &str in ferrod.rs. Can be git commit hash, cargo version, or Unix timestamp. Embedded in window._version_number in desk.html for cache-busting icon SVG fetches. Simple: const BUILD_VERSION: &str = "1780910475.4818158";

items.name: Language and layout direction (lang, is_rtl)
items.implementation_plan: Default: lang='en', layout_direction='ltr'. If boot.user.language in [ar, he, fa, ps], set layout_direction='rtl'. In desk.html: <html dir={{ layout_direction }} lang={{ lang }}>.

items.name: App name from config
items.implementation_plan: Read from frappe.conf or default to 'Frappe'. Used in <title> tag. Hardcode 'Frappe' for MVP.

items.name: Desk theme from user settings
items.implementation_plan: Read from boot.user.desk_theme. Default to 'Light'. Rendered in <html data-theme={{ desk_theme.lower() }}>.

items.name: Favicon URL
items.implementation_plan: Default to '/assets/frappe/images/frappe-favicon.svg'. Rendered in <link rel=icon href=> and <link rel=shortcut-icon href=>.

items.name: dev_server flag
items.implementation_plan: Hardcode dev_server=0 in ferrod desk.html. Embeds <script>window.dev_server = 0;</script>. CRITICAL: if true, Desk tries to connect to dev server and hangs on 404.

gotchas: dev_server MUST be 0/false. If true, Desk hangs trying to reach Vite dev server.
assets.json must be loaded at startup and cached. Hashed filenames are immutable; unhashed need shorter cache TTL.
Icon SVGs fetched client-side via fetch() in script tags, not link tags. include_icons() wraps in fetch + insertAdjacentHTML.
Boot JSON (~100-200KB) embedded inline in script tag. Use compact serde_json serialization (no pretty-printing).
Audio elements need correct MIME type (audio/mpeg) and cache headers.
Layout direction (RTL) set in <html dir=> attribute and CSS data-theme attributes.
CSRF token appears in TWO places: <script>frappe.csrf_token</script> and /api/* calls.
Asset resolution handles symlinks: sites/assets/frappe -> apps/frappe/frappe/public. Fallback to direct app path.
/app to /desk redirect server-side (301), hardcoded in PathResolver line 34 per hooks.py.
Query strings preserved on redirect via forward_query_parameters flag.
Icons fetched with credentials: same-origin (already in include_icons helper).
Boot.user may be minimal in stub. Template must handle missing nested properties.

subsystem: frappe.boot (bootinfo JSON payload for Desk SPA)
summary: The bootinfo JSON (~140KB) is embedded in the /desk HTML page and contains user identity, permission cache, UI config, and metadata needed for Desk to render and function. This spec divides the 70+ keys into: 11 BLOCKER keys (computed live from SQLite), 8 IMPORTANT keys (can be cached/snapshotted), 15 nice-to-have keys (can be stubbed), and 40+ ignorable keys (static or fetched on-demand). Recommended hybrid: live-compute user/sysdefaults/workspaces from DB; snapshot the rest from a baseline captured via served_boot.json.

items.name: user
items.implementation_plan: Query tabUser by session user via orm::get_doc(). Join tabHasRole to collect roles array. Compute can_read/can_write/etc perms via auth::Perm::user_perms(user, doctypes). Load user.defaults from tabSysDefaults WHERE user=?. Return full User document (~32KB). Must execute for every session, cached in Redis.
items.request_contract: N/A - internal computation from authenticated session

items.name: user_info
items.implementation_plan: Merge user.defaults into a dict keyed by username. For session user, fetch tabUser.time_zone, lang, desk_theme. Very lightweight (~200 bytes). Use existing orm + auth layer.

items.name: sysdefaults
items.implementation_plan: Query tabSysDefaults (key-value single). For each row, add to dict: setup_complete (computed from frappe.is_setup_complete()), time_zone, date_format, currency, etc. ~65 keys, ~2.2KB. Use direct SQL SELECT * FROM tabSysDefaults.

items.name: workspaces
items.implementation_plan: Call desktop::get_workspace_sidebar_items() logic in Rust. Query tabWorkspace WHERE restrict_to_domain IN (allowed_domains) AND module NOT IN (blocked_modules). For each row, permission-check via Workspace.is_permitted(). Enrich with module app_name from tabModuleDef. Filter for public/private/for_user. Return {"pages": [...], "has_access": bool, "has_create_access": bool}. ~3.6KB. This is the sidebar/workspace list.

items.name: workspace_sidebar_item
items.implementation_plan: Implementation of boot.get_sidebar_items(allowed_workspaces). Query tabWorkspaceSidebar then tabWorkspaceSidebarItem. For each, permission-check link_to/link_type. Translate labels. Enrich reports with ref_doctype. Build nested hierarchy. ~32KB. Critical for sidebar rendering.

items.name: modules
items.implementation_plan: Query tabModuleDef for allowed modules. Return as dict {module_name: {...}}. Can stub as {} since modules are usually loaded via page_info. In served_boot.json, this is empty {}.

items.name: module_list
items.implementation_plan: Extract keys from modules dict or PLUCK name FROM tabModuleDef WHERE name IN (allowed). Can stub as [] since workspaces+app_data provide the UI.

items.name: page_info
items.implementation_plan: Call boot.get_allowed_pages(). Query tabPage with role-based filters (Has Role + CustomRole). Return dict {page_name: {title, modified}}. ~812 bytes. Use same role-permission logic as in orm.

items.name: navbar_settings
items.implementation_plan: Query tabNavbar Settings (single doc). Fields: app_logo, app_logo_url, hide_search, etc. If not exists, return {}. Can snapshot from served_boot.json or fetch live (~1.5KB). Use orm::get_doc("Navbar Settings").

items.name: desk_settings
items.implementation_plan: Query tabUser field: desk_theme, sidebar_state, etc. Or use orm::get_doc and extract desk_properties. Lightweight (~200 bytes). Can stub as {}.

items.name: single_types
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDocType WHERE issingle=1. PLUCK name. ~31 items, 660 bytes. Desk uses this to know which doctypes can only have one instance. Direct SQL: SELECT name FROM tabDocType WHERE issingle=1.

items.name: nested_set_doctypes
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDocField WHERE fieldname='lft'. PLUCK parent (doctype). These are tree doctypes. Small list, can be cached. SQL: SELECT DISTINCT parent FROM tabDocField WHERE fieldname='lft'.

items.name: tree_view_doctypes
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDocType WHERE default_view='Tree'. PLUCK name. Desk uses for tree-list rendering. SQL: SELECT name FROM tabDocType WHERE default_view='Tree'.

items.name: doctype_layouts
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDocType Layout. Fields: name, title, document_type, based_on, is_standard, condition. ~2 bytes (empty in served boot). Can snapshot. Optional for desk: orm::get_all("DocType Layout").

items.name: desktop_icons
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDesktop Icon with permission filters. Called by get_desktop_icons(). Can stub as [] since sidebar provides navigation. ~3.2KB.

items.name: app_data
items.implementation_plan: Query installed apps from pyrt and tabModule Def. Build [{app_name, app_title, app_route, modules, workspaces}, ...]. Can snapshot from served_boot.json or stub as []. ~344 bytes.

items.name: lang
items.implementation_plan: Get from frappe.session.user's preferred language or tabUser.language. Fallback 'en'. Query tabUser.language for session user. ~4 bytes.

items.name: lang_dict
items.implementation_plan: Translation dict; loaded dynamically via frappe.translate.get_boot_translations() API call. Can stub as {} and defer to /api/method call. ~2.6KB if included.

items.name: sms_gateway_enabled
items.implementation_plan: Check tabSMS Settings.sms_gateway_url IS NOT NULL. Single query. Can hardcode false.

items.name: notification_settings
items.implementation_plan: Query tabNotification Settings (per-user single). Can stub as {} or fetch live. ~500 bytes. Desk uses for notification UI settings.

items.name: notification_unread_count
items.implementation_plan: Query COUNT(*) FROM tabNotification Log WHERE read=0 AND for_user=?. Single count. Can stub as 0.

items.name: home_page
items.implementation_plan: Query tabSysDefaults WHERE fieldname='desktop:home_page'. Fallback 'desktop'. Can hardcode 'desktop'. ~14 bytes.

items.name: setup_complete
items.implementation_plan: Query tabSysDefaults.setup_complete. Same as sysdefaults key. Can hardcode true for demo. ~1 byte.

items.name: frequently_visited_links
items.implementation_plan: Query tabRoute History for session user. Can stub as []. Desk uses for autocomplete suggestions. ~2 bytes in served boot.

items.name: onboarding_tours
items.implementation_plan: Query tabForm Tour. Can stub as []. Desk shows onboarding overlays but is optional. ~2 bytes.

items.name: docs
items.implementation_plan: Embedded metadata bundle: Country, Currency, Print Settings, and meta from get_meta_bundle(). Can snapshot as constant from served_boot.json or compute live by loading a few standard docs. ~46KB. For demo, stub as [] and let Desk fetch on demand.

items.name: sitename
items.implementation_plan: frappe.local.site (from request context). Hardcode to site name. ~15 bytes.

items.name: server_date
items.implementation_plan: frappe.utils.nowdate() -> today's date. Compute once per boot. ~12 bytes.

items.name: time_zone
items.implementation_plan: Merge system timezone with user timezone from user doc. ~54 bytes.

items.name: timezone_info
items.implementation_plan: Moment.js timezone data. Can stub as empty zones/rules/links. ~246 bytes. Computed by frappe.utils.momentjs.update().

items.name: assets_json
items.implementation_plan: Read assets.json from site assets directory (static file). Maps logical bundle name -> versioned asset path (e.g., 'desk.bundle' -> 'desk.bundle.HASH.js'). Must be read from disk or served as a constant. Ferrod should read /path/to/sites/assets/assets.json at boot and embed or pass through.

items.name: metadata_version
items.implementation_plan: frappe.client_cache.get_value("metadata_version") or reset_metadata_version(). A hash of all DocType metadata. Can hardcode a static value or compute from schema hash. ~58 bytes.

items.name: translations_version
items.implementation_plan: Similar to metadata_version. Can hardcode or compute from lang_dict hash. Used to cache-bust translation API calls. ~29 bytes.

items.name: versions
items.implementation_plan: Dict of app versions from get_versions(). Can snapshot or stub as {}. ~24 bytes.

items.name: calendars
items.implementation_plan: Hooks-based list from frappe.get_hooks('calendars'). Can stub as []. ~9 bytes.

items.name: treeviews
items.implementation_plan: Hooks-based list. Can stub as []. ~2 bytes.

items.name: link_preview_doctypes
items.implementation_plan: DocTypes with show_preview_popup=1. Can stub as []. Optional UI feature. ~2 bytes.

items.name: link_title_doctypes
items.implementation_plan: DocTypes with show_title_field_in_link=1. Query tabDocType WHERE show_title_field_in_link=1. Can stub. ~62 bytes.

items.name: letter_heads
items.implementation_plan: Query tabLetter Head. Unused by Desk. Can stub as {}. ~2 bytes.

items.name: dashboards
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDashboard. Can stub as []. Used for dashboard module, optional. ~2 bytes.

items.name: active_domains
items.implementation_plan: frappe.get_active_domains(). Used for permission filtering. Can stub as []. ~4 bytes.

items.name: all_domains
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDomain. Can stub as []. ~4 bytes.

items.name: translated_doctypes
items.implementation_plan: List of doctypes with translations. Can stub as []. ~88 bytes.

items.name: setup_wizard_requires
items.implementation_plan: Setup wizard config from hooks. Can stub as []. Only used if setup_complete=false. ~2 bytes.

items.name: setup_wizard_completed_apps
items.implementation_plan: List of apps with completed setup wizards. Can stub as []. ~2 bytes.

items.name: desk_theme
items.implementation_plan: User's desk theme preference from tabUser.desk_theme or hardcode 'Light'. ~7 bytes.

items.name: desktop_icon_style
items.implementation_plan: Query tabDesktop Settings.icon_style. Can hardcode 'Subtle'. ~7 bytes.

items.name: desktop_icon_urls
items.implementation_plan: Map of app -> [icon SVG paths]. Computed from /public/icons/desktop_icons dirs. Can stub as {} or snapshot from served_boot.json. ~1KB.

items.name: print_css
items.implementation_plan: Print stylesheet CSS string. Can stub as empty string or snapshot from served_boot.json. ~5KB. Unused by Desk.

items.name: error_report_email
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.error_report_email. Can stub as empty string. ~4 bytes.

items.name: disable_async
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.disable_async. Can hardcode false. ~4 bytes.

items.name: read_only
items.implementation_plan: Check frappe.flags.read_only. Can hardcode false. ~5 bytes.

items.name: developer_mode
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.developer_mode. Can hardcode false. ~1 byte.

items.name: socketio_port
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.socketio_port. Can stub as empty string (Desk degrades gracefully without socket.io). ~4 bytes.

items.name: file_watcher_port
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.file_watcher_port. Can stub as empty string. ~4 bytes.

items.name: max_file_size
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.max_file_size. Can hardcode or query. ~8 bytes.

items.name: file_chunk_size
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.file_chunk_size. Can hardcode. ~8 bytes.

items.name: home_folder
items.implementation_plan: Query tabFile WHERE is_home_folder=1. Can stub as empty string. ~6 bytes.

items.name: enable_address_autocompletion
items.implementation_plan: Query tabGeolocation Settings.enable_address_autocompletion. Can hardcode false. ~1 byte.

items.name: show_external_link_warning
items.implementation_plan: Query tabSystem Settings.show_external_link_warning or sysdefaults. Can hardcode 'Never'. ~7 bytes.

items.name: is_fc_site
items.implementation_plan: Check if on Frappe Cloud. Can hardcode false. ~5 bytes.

items.name: sentry_dsn
items.implementation_plan: Only include if enable_telemetry=true AND FRAPPE_SENTRY_DSN env var. Can stub as empty (omit from response). ~0 bytes.

items.name: success_action
items.implementation_plan: Query tabSuccess Action. Can stub as []. ~2 bytes.

items.name: email_accounts
items.implementation_plan: get_email_accounts(user=session.user). Can stub as {}. ~2 bytes.

items.name: all_accounts
items.implementation_plan: Email accounts. Can stub as {}. ~2 bytes.

items.name: additional_filters_config
items.implementation_plan: Hooks-based filters config. Can stub as {}. ~2 bytes.

items.name: app_logo_url
items.implementation_plan: Query tabNavbar Settings.app_logo_url or hooks. Can stub as empty string. ~49 bytes.

items.name: marketplace_apps
items.implementation_plan: Frappe Marketplace app list. Can stub as []. Requires external API call. ~2 bytes.

items.name: changelog_feed
items.implementation_plan: Query tabChangelog Feed. Can stub as []. ~2 bytes.

items.name: subscription_conf
items.implementation_plan: frappe.conf.subscription. Can hardcode empty string. ~4 bytes.

items.name: has_app_updates
items.implementation_plan: Check for app updates. Can hardcode false. ~5 bytes.

items.name: apps_data
items.implementation_plan: Lazy-loaded app metadata: {"apps": [...], "is_desk_apps": bool, "default_path": string}. Can snapshot from served_boot.json or compute via pyrt (if app detection needed). Required for routing. ~51 bytes baseline.

items.name: change_log
items.implementation_plan: Changelog entries for current request context. Only computed if frappe.local.request is set. Can stub as []. ~2 bytes.

items.name: notes
items.implementation_plan: get_unseen_notes(). Can stub as []. Query tabNote WHERE for_user=? AND seen=0. ~2 bytes.

items.name: telemetry_provider
items.implementation_plan: Telemetry provider config. Can stub as empty string. ~2 bytes.

items.name: telemetry_site_age
items.implementation_plan: Site age for telemetry. Can stub as empty string. ~1 byte.

items.name: module_app
items.implementation_plan: Dict mapping module name -> app name. Used by pyrt. Can snapshot from frappe.local.module_app. ~229 bytes.

items.name: module_wise_workspaces
items.implementation_plan: Query result from Workspace.get_module_wise_workspaces(). Can stub as {} or snapshot. ~107 bytes.

gotchas: workspaces and workspace_sidebar_item require complex multi-table joins with role-based permission filtering; both must be computed live from DB for correctness, not stubbed.
user and user_info depend on tabHasRole and tabSysDefaults joins; must compute permission arrays (can_read/can_write/etc) for every session, cannot cache as global constant.
sysdefaults is a key-value table (tabSysDefaults) with 65 entries; must query full table and flatten into dict; setup_complete flag is critical for Desk routing.
docs is a ~46KB embedded metadata bundle; expensive to compute (loads Country, Currency, Print Settings docs); snapshot from served_boot.json is strongly preferred; can stub as [] for minimal demo.

assets_json maps bundle names to versioned hashes (e.g., desk.bundle -> desk.bundle.HASH.js); must read from site's assets/assets.json static file at startup; hardcoding breaks if assets are re-built.
navbar_settings and desk_settings can be null if tabNavbar Settings or user.desk_properties don't exist; must handle DoesNotExist gracefully and return {} fallback.
page_info requires complex role permission checking (HasRole + CustomRole queries); use same Perm logic as orm; cannot be stubbed without losing access control.
single_types and nested_set_doctypes are static metadata queries; cache results in memory after first query; no permission filtering needed.
lang_dict is typically ~2.6KB but loaded dynamically via /api/method/frappe.translate.get_boot_translations; can stub as {} in initial boot and fetch on-demand to reduce payload.
desktop_icons, dashboards, letter_heads, and email_accounts require permission checks; can safely stub as empty for demo if Desk doesn't use them on first load.
/desk HTTP request must embed frappe.boot in <script> tag line 54 of desk.html; ferrod must serve the full rendered HTML with boot JSON injected, not just return JSON via API.
timezone_info is computed by frappe.utils.momentjs.update(); if moment.js is not available in Rust, can snapshot from served_boot.json or compute a minimal stub.
metadata_version and translations_version are hash strings used for cache-busting; can hardcode for first implementation, but should be dynamic (hash of schema + lang dict) in production.

subsystem: List view data stack (reportview, listview, user_settings endpoints)
summary: Specification for implementing list view endpoints in ferro to serve Frappe Desk list views. Covers frappe.desk.reportview.get/get_list/get_count, frappe.desk.listview.get_list_settings/get_group_by_count, frappe.model.utils.user_settings.get/save, and frappe.client.get_list/get_count. These endpoints power the /app/<doctype> list views and are critical for Desk navigation. Many are routable to ferro's existing orm::get_list/count with parameter mapping. Several can be stubbed as empty/noop responses initially.

items.name: frappe.desk.reportview.get
items.request_contract: POST /api/method/frappe.desk.reportview.get with form data: doctype (string), fields (JSON array of field names, may be backtick-quoted like "`tabToDo`.`name`"), filters (JSON array or object), or_filters (JSON), order_by (string), start (int), page_length (int), with_comment_count (bool), group_by (string optional)
items.response_contract: When data is empty: {"message": []}.  When data present: {"message": {"keys": [field1, field2, ...], "values": [[row1_val1, row1_val2, ...], [row2_val1, row2_val2, ...], ...], "user_info": {username: {avatar/initials dict}, ...}}}. The compressed form (keys+values) is ALWAYS returned by reportview.get when there are rows; empty list [] is returned when no rows (oracle shows reportview.get returns [] for ToDo with no data).
items.implementation_plan: Route POST /api/method/frappe.desk.reportview.get to a new handler. Parse form data: extract doctype, fields (strip backtick-quoted table prefix like `tabToDo`.name -> name), filters, or_filters, order_by, start/page_length. Build orm::ListQuery with stripped field names. Call orm::get_list(con, meta, acl, q, None). If result is empty, return {"message": []}. If result has rows, extract keys from first row's object keys, build values array (row-major: each row becomes a value array in field order), extract _assign fields and build user_info dict. Return {"message": {"keys": keys, "values": values, "user_info": user_info}}.

Parse params/form, extract doctype, fields, filters, or_filters, order_by, start, page_length (map 'limit' param to page_length). Strip field name quotes/table prefix. Call orm::count(con, meta, filters_json) which returns i64. Return {"message": count}. No timeout logic needed for SQLite.

items.name: field name stripping (backtick/table prefix handling)
items.request_contract: Fields in requests come as backtick-quoted with table prefix, e.g. [\"\`tabToDo\`.\`name\`\", \"\`tabToDo\`.\`status\`\", \"\`tabUser\`.\`email\`\"] or plain names like [\"name\", \"status\"]

items.implementation_plan: In all handlers that parse fields param: strip backticks and table prefix. Regex pattern: for each field, find last '.' after removing backticks, take the part after. Example: `tabToDo`.`name` -> name. Also handle nested fields from child tables (tablefield.fieldname -> extract fieldname). ferro's orm::get_list already handles this stripping at line 303-304 (f.rsplit('.').next().unwrap_or(f)), so no change needed there. Ensure all /api/method handlers do the same stripping before calling orm::get_list.

items.name: route /api/method/* in ferrod
items.request_contract: POST /api/method/frappe.<module>.<function> with form-urlencoded body. GET with query params also supported for read-only methods.
items.response_contract: {"message": <result>} where result depends on the method.
items.implementation_plan:
In ferrod.rs route() function (line 254), add match arm for 'method' segment (currently only 'resource' is handled, line 275). Parse the method path (e.g. frappe.desk.reportview.get). Dispatch to appropriate handler per the method name. Handlers should:
1. Parse form data (POST body or query params)
2. Call appropriate orm/db functions
3. Return (status_code, json_value) where json_value already contains {"message": ...} wrapper
Note: Current ferrod only implements 'ping' and 'frappe.auth.get_logged_user' methods (lines 270-271); extend this match statement.

items.name: response envelope consistency
items.request_contract: Desk expects consistent response envelopes across /api/resource and /api/method endpoints
items.response_contract: /api/resource/* returns {"data": ...} (REST convention, line 322 in ferrod). /api/method/* returns {"message": ...} (Frappe RPC convention). Desk should handle both, but verify by tracing real requests.
items.implementation_plan: Current ferrod returns {"data": value} for resource endpoints. reportview.get/get_list/get_count and user_settings methods return {"message": value}. Ensure method handlers return correct wrapper. client.get_list may be called as both /api/resource/DocType and /api/method/frappe.client.get_list — test both and ensure Desk works with both.

gotchas: reportview.get returns COMPRESSED format (keys/values arrays) when data exists, but EMPTY ARRAY [] when no data — NOT an empty compressed object. This is critical: {"message": []} NOT {"message": {"keys":[], "values":[], "user_info":{}}}.
Field names in requests are backtick-quoted with table prefix (e.g. "`tabToDo`.`name`") but orm::get_list expects unquoted names. Stripping must happen in all handlers before calling orm functions.
user_settings.get returns a JSON string (double-encoded), but .save returns the parsed dict. Check oracle carefully—responses show the actual shapes used by Desk.
Frappe's reportview.get_count uses a 1-second timeout on MariaDB to avoid expensive queries. SQLite has no built-in query timeout; for now, ignore timeout logic.
List View Settings is a single-document doctype where the primary key (name) is the doctype name itself. A request for ToDo returns a doc with name=ToDo if it exists, else nothing.
user_info dict in compressed response is only populated if _assign field is present and non-empty in the results. For doctypes without _assign, it's always {}.
/api/resource/<doctype> GET returns {"data": array}, not {"message": array}. Desk may call both styles; ensure compatibility.
The 'view' parameter in reportview is validated but not used by ferro—it's metadata about which list view the client is rendering (e.g. view='List' vs view='Report'). Ferro can ignore it.

with_comment_count, save_user_settings, save_user_settings_fields are all Frappe-side list view features. Ferro can ignore them for MVP (Desk works without comment count; user settings can be stubbed).
group_by and aggregate functions are advanced; stub get_group_by_count initially. They are called when user clicks a filter facet sidebar, not on initial list load.

summary: HTTP session and CSRF support using cookie-based session IDs (sid), login method, and whitelisted boot methods for toolbar initialization. Demo can accept any CSRF token or turn validation off; real impl validates against tabSessions.csrf_token. Socket.io 404s gracefully (Desk degrades without realtime). setup_wizard methods stubbed (setup_complete=1 in boot). Session uses sid cookie from tabSessions.

items.name: /api/method/login (POST usr, pwd)
items.implementation_plan: POST body: usr=username&pwd=password. (1) Validate credentials against tabUser.name & __Auth.password (compare hashed). (2) Create Sessions record: insert (sid=uuid, user, csrf_token=random, creation, lastupdate). (3) Return 200 + Set-Cookie: sid, system_user, full_name, user_id, user_image. Call tabUser get_user_type to set system_user=yes/no. (4) frappe uses hashed passwords (werkzeug); see check_password in frappe/utils/password.py. Use rusqlite to query tabUser; for password hash matching use password verification library or Frappe's logic.

Fallback to Authorization header if no sid. Update session lastupdate on each request (query tabSessions, increment lastupdate). Expire sessions: delete from tabSessions WHERE lastupdate < now()-24h. For demo, accept any sid or hardcode Administrator.

(2) Real impl: Read X-Frappe-CSRF-Token header; query tabSessions WHERE sid=<current_sid>, compare header value to sessions.csrf_token. GET/OPTIONS bypass. Socket.io requests & /socket.io/* have no CSRF. POST/PUT/DELETE w/o valid token -> 403 CSRFTokenError.

items.response_contract: 401/403 if invalid. 200 if valid or GET/OPTIONS or ignore_csrf=1.

items.name: /api/method/frappe.core.doctype.session_default_settings.session_default_settings.get_session_default_values (GET)
items.implementation_plan: Query tabSessionDefaultSettings. Return list of dicts {doctype, fieldname, value} or empty list. Desk uses for custom defaults.

items.name: /api/method/frappe.core.doctype.background_task.background_task.get_recent_tasks (POST limit=N)
items.implementation_plan: Query tabBackgroundTask WHERE user=<current_user> ORDER BY modified DESC LIMIT N. Return list. For demo: return empty list.

items.name: /api/method/frappe.translate.get_boot_translations (GET lang=en)
items.implementation_plan: Return translation map for language. Load from app i18n files or return minimal static dict. Desk caches this heavily. For demo: empty dict or just country names (shown in oracle).

items.name: /api/method/frappe.desk.page.setup_wizard.setup_wizard.load_languages (POST)
items.implementation_plan: Stub: return empty. Only called if setup_complete=0 in boot. Desk checks boot.sysdefaults.setup_complete=1, so this endpoint is NOT hit in demo.

items.name: /api/method/frappe.desk.page.setup_wizard.setup_wizard.load_user_details (POST)
items.implementation_plan: Stub: return empty. Only called if setup_complete=0. NOT hit in demo (see setup_complete above).

items.name: /socket.io/* (WebSocket handshake and messages)
items.implementation_plan: Return 404 or 501. Desk degrades gracefully: checks navigator.onLine and socket status. No realtime updates (document changes, notifications) but CRUD works. Tests confirm pageErrors=0 even with 404.

items.name: Boot endpoint aggregation (Desk load)
items.implementation_plan: NOT a single endpoint; Desk calls individual methods sequentially to build in-memory boot. Key items: (1) get_logged_user -> user {name, roles, defaults, permissions, ...}. (2) Individual DocType metas via /api/method/frappe.desk.form.load.getdoctype. (3) Translations, apps, roles. Ferro can: (a) pre-compute boot.json at startup and serve cached, or (b) respond to each individual method call. For minimal demo: hardcode boot.user.roles from tabHasRole query, boot.sysdefaults.setup_complete=1, boot.user.defaults from tabSysDefault.
items.request_contract: Multiple GET/POST calls to /api/method/* in sequence
items.response_contract: Frappe.boot object built in JS from responses; must include: boot.user (name, roles, defaults, permissions), boot.sysdefaults (setup_complete=1, ...), boot.docs (meta for doctypes), boot.versions, etc.

items.name: /desk (HTML page with embedded boot & CSRF token)
items.implementation_plan: Serve static desk.html template. Embed <script>frappe.csrf_token = '<value>'</script> + <input name=csrf_token value=...> for forms. Generate fresh CSRF token from tabSessions on each page load. Return HTML with asset bundle hashes from assets.json and JS loader script. Redirect /app to /desk (v17 behavior).
items.response_contract: 200 + HTML with <head><script> frappe.csrf_token='...' </script>, desk bundles (.css/.js), asset map. Set-Cookie: sid if needed.

gotchas: CSRF token must be set in HTTP header X-Frappe-CSRF-Token for all non-safe methods; can be extracted from form or generated fresh. Demo can ignore (set frappe.conf.ignore_csrf or hardcode pass).
Session (sid) cookie must be HttpOnly and Lax SameSite to match Frappe's behavior; HTTP-only prevents JS access (security).
Password hashing: Frappe uses werkzeug.security (check_password / generate_password_hash). Rust impl must either call Python via PyO3 or reimplement the hash check (PBKDF2 or bcrypt).
setup_complete=1 in boot.sysdefaults prevents setup_wizard calls; ferro must set this to skip those endpoints entirely.
get_all_roles must return role names as strings, not HAS ROLE doc objects; query tabRole.name or DISTINCT role FROM tabHasRole.
Socket.io 404 is acceptable; Desk JS has fallback for realtime unavailable.
Desk makes rapid parallel calls for doctype metas, translations, apps, roles at boot; ensure session.lastupdate is updated per-request, not on every sub-call.
User roles in boot.user.roles must include implicit 'All', 'Guest', 'Desk User' per Frappe conventions; query tabHasRole + implicit roles.
Timezones are static IANA timezone names (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'); can be hardcoded or loaded from a static file.
get_logged_user is a simple pass-through of frappe.session.user; must resolve from sid cookie session lookup.
